items.title: Meet the only Scot managing a national team in world football
items.description: More than 4,000 miles from his native Dundee, Kurt Herd is flying the flag for Scotland in international football - as manager of Dominica's national side.

items.title: Man City sponsor Etihad Airways considering legal action against PL
items.description: Manchester City's principal sponsor, Etihad Airways, has said it is considering taking legal action against the Premier League.

items.title: Punish Man City this season, say other club chiefs
items.description: Manchester City's punishment for breaching Premier League rules should be handed down before the end of this season, senior football figures tell BBC Sport.

items.description: Germany forward Kevin Schade is wanted by Liverpool, Erling Haaland and Phil Foden are among the Manchester City players drawing interest from Europe's top clubs, plus more.

items.title: Ronaldo makes 'irreversible decision' over Portugal future - reports
Ronaldo walks out of Portugal camp and vows to reveal 'the truth'
items.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has left Portugal's camp in Denmark and vowed to reveal "the truth" behind his departure in due course.

items.title: Classy Hammarby end Rangers' Europa Cup hopes
items.description: Rangers exit the Europa Cup after last season's finalists Hammarby leave Broadwood Stadium with a three-goal victory on the night to progress 5-0 on aggregate.

items.title: Infantino should have no place in future of football - Pinto
items.description: The computer hacker who released documents which led to the Premier League investigation into Manchester City says Gianni Infantino "should have no place in the future of the game".

items.title: Bizarre handball blunder sees Arsenal squander two-goal lead vs Paris FC
items.description: Arsenal's tough start to the season continued as Leah Williamson gave away a freak penalty late on to see Paris FC come from two goals behind to draw 2-2 with the Gunners.
